title: On permutation-invariant construction of glued lattices
summary: Given a permutation $τ$ on $n$ letters, we consider lattices spanned by an orbit of one vector $\boldsymbol x$ in $\mathbb R^n$ under the action of $τ$ by permutation of the coordinates. Such lattices generalize the important class of cyclic lattices and have previously been studied in~\cite{perm}, where a bound on their rank was established. We prove a sufficient condition on $\boldsymbol x$ for this bound to be achieved.
